meta.title: untodo - Type-safe TODO for humans and AI
meta.description: Type-safe replacement for // TODO: comments. Trackable, structured, and lint-enforceable.

hero.tagline: Type-safe TODO for humans and AI - trackable, structured, and lint-enforceable.
hero.sub: Type-safe replacement for // TODO: comments. Trackable in your IDE, enforceable by lint, surfaced by the type system.

items.title: Type-Safe
items.body: TODO() returns never, so it's part of the type system the moment you write it - not something a reviewer can miss like a comment. Callers keep type-checking as-is, with no need for fake casts like as User.

items.title: Leave the to-do list in a way that makes it unpleasant
items.body: A row of neat // TODO: comments is easy to feel fine about. untodo makes a TODO fail the build via ESLint / oxlint instead, so leaving one in place stays uncomfortable until it's resolved.

items.title: Everywhere it can run
items.body: Works on Node.js, Bun, and Deno. Published on both npm and JSR, and built as native ESM.

items.title: No dependency
items.body: Zero runtime dependencies. The library itself is about 1.4KB - no throw, no reflection, no I/O, just a minimal optional handler call.

items.title: For AI harness
items.body: AI reads comments as plain text, but TODO() is a function call backed by type information and a signature. AI coding assistants like Claude Code pick up the existence and intent of a TODO far more reliably.

items.title: Detect by linter
items.body: The untodo/eslint plugin ships no-todo / no-fixme / no-hack rules. Works with both ESLint and oxlint to ban comment-style TODOs and enforce the function-call form.

footer.tagline: Type-safe TODO for humans and AI.
